scripts.setup: cd backend && npm install && cd ../web && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../web && npm run build
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,magenta "cd backend && npm run start:prod" "cd web && npm run start"
scripts.setup:flutter: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && flutter pub get
scripts.dev:flutter: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "cd frontend && npm run start"
scripts.build:flutter: cd backend && npm run build && cd ../frontend && flutter build web
